source_title: One result does not 'erase' Swansea progress - Matos - BBC
source_excerpt:
Matos - 'One result doesn't erase what we're doing'
Swansea City head coach says the shock 5-0 defeat at Queens Park Rangers does not diminish what they have achieved so far in the Championship this season.
The Swans remain second in the table despite the heavy loss at Loftus Road.
Matos says "result-wise" it was among his hardest days as a manager but not his worst.
